mainEntity.name: What is the fare for a Varanasi to Ram Mandir Tempo Traveller?

acceptedAnswer.text: A 12 seater Tempo Traveller for a Varanasi to Ram Mandir day trip is ₹14,500 all-inclusive; 17 seaters range ₹15,500–₹16,500 depending on festival demand.

mainEntity.name: How early should we leave Varanasi for Ram Mandir darshan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depart 4:30–5:00 AM to clear Prayagraj bypass traffic and reach Ayodhya reporting zone by 9:30 AM for priority queue slots.

mainEntity.name: Can you arrange Ram Mandir VIP or Sugam Darshan passes?

acceptedAnswer.text: We guide pilgrims through the official Shri Ram Janmabhoomi portal to block Sugam Darshan slots and coordinate queue navigation on arrival.

mainEntity.name: Is a same-day return comfortable for elders?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes with rest halts every 90 minutes, light snacks, and push-back seats; many families also add a short post-lunch nap window before departure.
